newsitem.title: USA: Grand Coulee dam power turbine seen down over wknd.
newsitem.headline: Grand Coulee dam power turbine seen down over wknd.

text.p: An 805 megawatt (MW) power turbine at the Grand Coulee hydroelectric dam in Washington state will remain shut until Monday as repairs continue, a spokesman for the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation said Friday.
The unit, which was upgraded recently from a capacity of 750 MW, had been expected to restart late Wednesday after being taken off-line on Tuesday.
"We have identified the problem and hope to have it fixed in a day or two--that probably means by Monday since this is Friday," the spokesman said.
Grand Coulee's total generating capacity is near 2,000 MW, but a segment of its turbines are taken off-line in shifts for regular maintenance.
